name: Turbidity Sensor
fullName: Optical Water Turbidity and Clarity Detection Sensor Module
tagline: Measures total suspended solids (TSS) and water clarity using optical transmittance
description: The Turbidity Sensor utilizes an optical light transmitter and receiver to measure the scattering and transmittance of light through water. When suspended particles or contaminants are present, light transmission decreases, producing a lower analog voltage that correlates with NTU (Nephelometric Turbidity Units).

specs.outputType: Analog Voltage (0–4.5V) and Digital Threshold Trigger (DO)

pinout.name: Analog Out
pinout.desc: Analog voltage proportional to water clarity (4.1V+ = clean water)

wiringNote: Only immerse the lower optical probe into water; do not submerge the probe's top wire connection or adapter PCB.
commonMistakes: Submerging entire probe including top plastic sealing head
Reading raw values without voltage-to-NTU calibration formula
